description: List messages newest first with their delivery status, including held, scheduled, skipped and failed ones and the mail campaigns and automations sent. Filter by status or recipient. Paged: at most 100 per call; while has_more is true, next_cursor passed back as cursor with the same filters returns the next page. An unknown status is refused with 422 invalid_request rather than answering an empty log.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, passed back unchanged

status.description: rejected: every recipient was suppressed or opted out, so nothing was sent. canceled: a scheduled send was cancelled. failed: the provider refused it, or a scheduled send could not go out

name: list_emails
